firebase_uid: zs_ + lowercase hex HMAC-SHA-256 of the exact Zo Stream user ID string using a dedicated stable server secret

rooms/{roomId}.purpose: minimal room metadata; preserve the existing SQL room ID

room_authz/{roomId}/{firebaseUid}/{sessi.purpose: short-lived projection of SQL permission decisions, scoped to Firebase UID and chat_sid

auth_sessions/{firebaseUid}/{sessionId}.purpose: rules-checkable session revocation and bounded authorization lease

user_rooms/{firebaseUid}/{roomId}.purpose: room discovery index; contains only rooms currently visible to this user

user_account_events/{firebaseUid}/{outbo.owner: trusted backend only; account-scoped invalidation stream
user_account_events/{firebaseUid}/{outbo.retention: at most 500 per account and 7 days
user_account_events/{firebaseUid}/{outbo.purpose: invalidates canonical SQL unread or room discovery snapshots without exposing private room IDs or duplicating unread state

messages/{roomId}/{messageId}.owner: trusted backend only; clients submit through the authenticated Laravel chat API
messages/{roomId}/{messageId}.ordering: stable SQL message ID; trusted projection preserves canonical SQL order

user_messages/{firebaseUid}/{roomId}/{me.owner: trusted backend only; per-user live feed filtered by current SQL block and room authorization policy
user_messages/{firebaseUid}/{roomId}/{me.purpose: recently authorized per-user realtime cache without exposing messages from users blocked by the recipient; retains at most 100 messages per room and 7 days, with SQL reconciliation for older history

user_sync_events/{firebaseUid}/{roomId}/.owner: trusted backend only; per-user event stream after SQL authorization and block filtering
user_sync_events/{firebaseUid}/{roomId}/.retention: at most 500 events per user and room and 7 days; SQL provides block-filtered reconciliation when a cursor expires

user_typing/{firebaseUid}/{roomId}/{typi.owner: trusted backend only; written only for currently authorized room viewers after two-way SQL block filtering
user_typing/{firebaseUid}/{roomId}/{typi.retention: ephemeral; expires within 30 seconds, normally within 6 seconds; removed on stop and cleared on block/session restoration
user_typing/{firebaseUid}/{roomId}/{typi.purpose: realtime typing indicators without SQL event history or per-keystroke publication

reactions/{roomId}/{messageId}/{firebase.owner: trusted backend only; user operations remain on the authenticated Laravel API

read_receipts/{roomId}/{firebaseUid}.owner: trusted backend only; user operations remain on the authenticated Laravel API

typing/{roomId}/{firebaseUid}.owner: trusted backend only; user operations remain on the authenticated Laravel API

sync_events/{roomId}/{eventId}.retention: bounded per room; consumers recover with a bounded canonical-data reconciliation when a cursor expires

client_write_policy.messages: clients submit through Laravel's existing SQL-authoritative API, which validates permissions, slow-mode, blocks, replies and content; trusted outbox delivery publishes only accepted messages
client_write_policy.reactions: Laravel API validates and stores reactions; Firebase writes are trusted-only
client_write_policy.read_receipts: Laravel API validates and stores read positions; Firebase writes are trusted-only
client_write_policy.typing: Laravel API validates and coalesces typing; trusted backend writes short-lived recipient-scoped typing state, never client writes
